data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Mikhaēl' meaning 'who is like God?'. In the Bible, Michael is an archangel, known as the leader of the heavenly forces. He is often depicted as a protector and defender of God's people. The name Micheil carries the meaning “Who is like God?” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Micheil usually hope their child will grow to embody who is like god? and live with faith, good character and purpose.
